evidence.finding: Names 35 detected CLI integrations, with provider-specific hooks, resume and model/effort options; remote CLIs must be installed and authenticated remotely.

evidence.title: Emdash Automations
evidence.finding: Cron prompts run on the project machine. The remote Workspace Server schedules without a connected desktop, except steps needing desktop services. Runs link to tasks and expose errors.

evidence.title: Emdash Telemetry
evidence.locator: Summary; Opt Out; What We Collect
evidence.finding: Production telemetry defaults on, uses allowlisted PostHog events, can attach account identity after sign-in, and has settings/environment opt-out.

evidence.title: Emdash Remote Development
evidence.finding: The remote Workspace Server handles repos, agents, terminals and scheduling over SSH; local credentials are not automatically copied.

evidence.title: Emdash Tmux Sessions
evidence.finding: Optional tmux retains terminal/TUI processes across app disconnects, but not reboot. Local Windows sessions do not use tmux.

evidence.title: Emdash Diff View
evidence.finding: Documents file staging, diffs and Git workflow actions.

evidence.title: Emdash CI/CD Checks

evidence.title: Emdash Library

evidence.title: Emdash Roadmap

evidence.title: Emdash desktop build
evidence.finding: The documented desktop client uses Electron.

evidence.title: What is next for Emdash
evidence.finding: The team describes a coming cloud-first team product and a waitlist; Classic docs remain separate.

evidence.title: Emdash in-app browser
evidence.finding: Task browser previews can forward remote ports and restore saved tabs/profiles. It does not reuse system-browser profiles or extensions.

evidence.title: Emdash v1.2.11
evidence.finding: v1.2.11 fixes Windows Git authentication, SSH responsiveness and adds an Emdash 2.0 waitlist card.

evidence.title: Emdash Classic

evidence.title: Emdash Where to find it; Actions; Inline editing
evidence.locator: Where to find it; Actions; Inline editing
evidence.finding: Classic updates changed/staged files from workspace Git events and offers unified/split diffs, inline editing of unstaged files, stage/unstage/discard, commit, push and create PR. Discard asks confirmation. PR views show files, commits, checks, comments and merge state; GitHub account/remote required for PR operations.

evidence.title: Emdash Viewing checks; Refreshing check runs; Requirements
evidence.locator: Viewing checks; Refreshing check runs; Requirements
evidence.finding: Checks display pass/fail/pending/skipped, source, timing and links for the PR current head commit; opening Checks or a new head refreshes GitHub data. PR comments appear below checks. Requires a selected GitHub account, PR and configured checks.

evidence.title: Emdash Library sections
evidence.finding: Library saves reusable prompts for new or existing conversations, installs/creates skills and configures MCP servers. Remote configuration is scoped to that machine and is not automatically copied from the laptop.

evidence.title: Emdash Create an automation; Review runs
evidence.finding: Scheduled runs select name, project, cron, prompt, agent and workspace. History shows timing, status and errors with associated task/conversation links. Runs can become regular tasks. Pausing stops future schedules.

evidence.title: Emdash Supported providers; Feature support; Remote agents
evidence.locator: Supported providers; Feature support; Remote agents
evidence.finding: Classic names Pi and Grok among its 35 CLI providers. Auto-approve skips file-operation permission prompts for the providers that support it; resume/hooks vary by provider. evidence.title: Emdash homepage

evidence.title: Emdash docs
evidence.finding: The docs cover Emdash Classic, an open-source desktop app.

evidence.title: emdash LICENSE.md
evidence.locator: Apache License 2.0, section 2 (Grant of Copyright License)

evidence.title: Emdash /pricing
evidence.finding: The /pricing path returned 404; a missing pricing page does not prove anything about price.

evidence.title: Emdash Claude Code auth status check
evidence.locator: packages/plugins/src/agents/impl/claude/auth.ts lines 17-33 and 46-56 (claudeAuthStatus, accountFromAuthStatus), release v1.2.11 commit 9346e91
evidence.finding: Emdash treats Claude Code as authenticated when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set or when the installed claude CLI reports a signed-in account through its own auth status, including an OAuth account; Emdash holds no model credentials of its own.

evidence.title: Emdash Providers docs
evidence.locator: Supported Providers, Remote agents and Adding a Provider sections (last updated 2026-10-17)
evidence.finding: Emdash detects installed provider CLIs on PATH; some CLIs need their own account authentication before Emdash can run them, and on remote machines the user installs and authenticates the CLI there.

evidence.title: Emdash Antigravity support at v1.2.11
